manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Glamermite using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Glamermite to Yenna and causing Glamermite to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
